title: French farmer meets an NHI holding a tray of soil samples

tellings.quote: there's this great case in France where a you know a very trusted respected farmer discovers a a spaceship on his land and then he goes up to it and then there's supposedly an nhi there holding a tray full of of soil samples

plain: In France, a trusted and respected farmer is said to have found a spaceship on his land, walked up to it, and met an NHI, short for non-human intelligence, a being that is not human, holding a tray full of soil samples. The journalist Michael Shellenberger tells Michels this as a case from the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, and says the being was there only "supposedly". If true, it would suggest the visitors were out here collecting samples of the Earth.
